evidence_kind: Focused inert REA, hashed manual source review and independent read-only backend fixtures; Cloud workflow and visual acceptance remain open

contract.native_request: Vendor service JWT creation with page-local request ID.
contract.response: Correlated id/status: success token, no_license_found or generic_error.
contract.gate: cloud_drive_cleaner.manage: available/beta starts; upsell/expired upgrade or renew; other states disable.
contract.correlation: Three-second reply acceptance, no page-level pending/timeout state, disconnected send not checked by the page.
contract.handoff: Successful nonempty token goes to vendor external cloud flow via open-browser; no native browser/page-load acknowledgement.
contract.provider_choices: Original saved screenshots show Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox and Google Mail.
contract.limits: External service account/results/effects and native JWT service execution not inspected. Vendor tokens, credentials, analytics and support services are not reused.

primary_sources.use: Fixed files.list query, pagination, requested fields and incompleteSearch.
Optional size, version, MIME, trash and provider checksum metadata; content hashes do not cover every file type.
permissionId from about.user identifies the observed Drive user; no email/photo requested.
Builder documentation checked alongside the locally pinned 0.13.5 source; redirects/retries/proxies/compression disabled and request timeouts set.
Future DCleaner-owned native client registration and authorization; no authorization was attempted.

inventory.note: Provider type is not a provider integration.
inventory.scope: Immutable provider/subject/storage identity; cursors bind to it; current scope checked before/after each page.
inventory.failures: Typed source/limit/malformed/duplicate-id/cursor/scope/deadline/cancel issues retain known partial rows; no failed empty success. Deadline cannot interrupt a blocked adapter call.
inventory.classification: Observed large size with exact/estimate provenance; same-namespace hash review candidates; contradictory exact sizes are conflicts. No content equality, unused/safety score, quota saving, effect authority or deletion plan.

google_drive.implemented: Real independent read-only adapter, not connected to an account or UI in this slice.
requests: GET https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files with fixed corpora=user,spaces=drive,trashed=false,shared-drive support,fields and pageSize=1000; encoded opaque pageToken only
google_drive.visibility: Only items visible to the granted token and exact query. Complete pagination is neither entire-account coverage nor an atomic remote snapshot.
google_drive.transport: Native TLS validation, HTTPS only, no redirects/retries/proxies/compression or arbitrary URLs; 10-second connect and 30-second request timeout with additional deadline/body checks.
google_drive.token: No Debug/Serialize/accessor or persistence; owned input buffer zeroized on drop. Transport-internal copies are not claimed scrubbed; OAuth/expiry/refresh owner still absent.
google_drive.remote_effects: No upload, download, Trash/delete or recovery API.

design.inspection: Only supplied saved screenshots viewed. No Cloud UI, renderer, browser or app window was launched.
design.authority: CCleaner screenshots define functional layout; accepted navy/blue screenshot family governs future DCleaner design.
design.acceptance: No new Cloud native page or visual acceptance established.
